d:
Rahul Gandhi has invited people, student groups, and citizens from across the country to join a march at Ramlila Maidan in New Delhi on November 1. In his message, he described the march as a movement to protect democracy, the Constitution, and the right to freedom of expression. He said the protest is not limited to any one political party but is about safeguarding the country's democratic values. Rahul Gandhi also urged students, regardless of their political affiliations, to participate in the march.
